articles.title: Fed policymakers at odds over causes of high inflation
articles.desc: US inflation is expected to increase again in October, with potential implications for Federal Reserve interest rate decisions. Economists predict the Personal Consumption Expenditures Price Index to reach 3.8% this month. Analysts are divided regarding whether inflation is caused by demand or supply shocks stemming from recent policies. Market forecasts suggest three more rate hikes, signaling ongoing concerns about rising prices.

articles.title: Shapoor Mistry lobbied Modi twice for Tata Sons IPO as battle over listing intensifies
articles.desc: Shapoor Mistry, the head of the Shapoorji Pallonji Group, has reached out to Prime Minister Modi regarding the listing troubles faced by Tata Sons. He claims that Tata Trusts are obstructing the public offering for their own benefit and breaching regulations. Meanwhile, the Reserve Bank of India has pressured Tata Sons to meet listing necessities.

articles.title: PhonePe resumes IPO process; targets February-March listing at $12-15 billion valuation
articles.desc: PhonePe has resumed its initial public offering plans after deferring them due to market uncertainties. The company aims for a stock market listing valued between USD 12-15 billion in early 2024. It expects to raise approximately Rs 12,000-14,000 crore through an offer-for-sale. The digital payments firm has also reported significant revenue growth and is now profitable at the group level.
